scope: YouTube videos keep playing past the first minute.

topics.title: YouTube in your own Chrome
details: YouTube stops videos after about a minute in a browser a program controls. It says something went wrong.
Now YouTube always opens in your own Chrome, so videos play without stopping. This needs the Voice Companion extension in Chrome.
If Chrome is closed, Voice Companion opens it and gives your keys back. Your keys work the same.
If a video still stops, it goes on in your own Chrome, from where it stopped.

topics.title: YouTube messages
details: YouTube's error no longer ends with the words Learn more.
